issues.problem: Story said 'the court' was preparing to flee; in 南齐书·王敬则传 it is the crown prince (later 东昏侯) who packed up ready to flee.
issues.action: Corrected that detail; rest of the story and source kept.

issues.problem: Misuse 2 (two classmates doing homework together) is not clearly wrong: the saying has a secondary sense that one person alone cannot get something done.
issues.action: Replaced with a literal-silence misuse that is clearly wrong.

issues.problem: Story asserted the poet 'consoles himself' with the line, an interpretation the poem's traditional reading (melancholy at spring's end) does not support with certainty.

Story source gave chapter 38, which differs between editions (37 in the 70-chapter text); the saying's original form in the novel is 不打不成相识; one context translation was off ('you don't really know someone till you've clashed').
issues.action: Source cut to 《水浒传》, original wording noted in the story, context translation corrected.
